reference: Preferred agents under sulfonamides include sulfamethoxazole/trimethoprim, Bactrim, Sulfatrim suspension, and Bactrim DS. Preferred agents under tetracyclines include demeclocycline tablet, doxycycline hyclate 50 mg and 100 mg capsules, Doryx tablet, Doryx MPC tablet, doxycycline hyclate tablet, doxycycline hyclate 75 mg capsule, doxycycline monohydrate 50 mg and 100 mg capsules, doxycycline hyclate DR tablet, doxycycline monohydrate suspension, doxycycline IR-DR capsule, doxycycline monohydrate tablet, doxycycline monohydrate 75 mg and 150 mg capsules, minocycline capsule, minocycline tablet, tetracycline capsule, minocycline ER tablet, Morgidox capsule, Morgidox Kit, Nuzyra tablet, and Oracea capsule.
